title: Swan Districts
style: post-punk drive, 100 BPM, driving drums, distorted guitar verses, clean open chorus, decisive energy, fierce maternal theme, no sentimentality, direct delivery, raw male vocal NZ/AU accent, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — driving drums, guitar riff]

[VERSE 1 — punchy, direct]
Swan Districts Hospital
She didn't wait in line
She walked past the queue of people
Like she had a sign

The doctor said he's stable
She said he's more than that
She made the call they didn't make
She knew where I was at

[PRE-CHORUS]
No hesitation
No apology
She walked through the door
Like she owned the lobby

[CHORUS]
Swan Districts
Mother doesn't wait
Swan Districts
She already knows the stakes
Swan Districts
She made the decision
Swan Districts
Precision

[VERSE 2]
They say I was okay after
She says I was not
She was right — she's always right
She kept that one in her gut

NZ to Western Australia
She carried everything
Built a family from two people
Taught everyone to sing

[BRIDGE — quieter, direct]
You don't ask her twice.
She already decided.
You don't explain.
She already understands.

[FINAL CHORUS]
Swan Districts
She didn't hesitate
Swan Districts
She was never late
Swan Districts
She carried it all
Swan Districts
She answered the call

[OUTRO — drums alone fading]
